race.description: Tatts Hotel Inverell Cellarbrations Bottle Shop Mdn Plate (C1)
race.comment: HARD AS BROK (3) doesn't boast the best winning strike rate but ran a strong race last time out, finishing third and beaten only 1.5 lengths over 1600m at Moree. Finds a suitable assignment and can take the next step and salute. GRAFOLOGY (7) finished fourth two runs back then did well last start but found a couple better over 1750m at Muswellbrook, beaten only 0.7 lengths after being in contention on the corner. Beautifully placed and is sure to prove tough to beat. FLYING PHOENIX (11) finished 5.5 lengths away in fifth last time out over 1400m at Gatton two weeks ago. Steps up in journey today. Drawn out but does go back and will be strong late. One of the contenders. CUT DIAMONDS (8) was out of the money two runs back then again missed the frame last start over 1905m at Ballina, beaten 6 lengths into seventh. Capable of featuring prominently.
